comparison.objective: Seat four wired connector modules in a sprung hinged frame and close it until latched.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated tight-clearance insertion of adjacent modules followed by closure without dislodging them.
comparison.success_condition: Full credit requires all four modules seated within millimetre tolerances, frame clicked shut, hands clear, and a one-second hold; dropped or crushed modules fail.
comparison.reason: Multi-part insertion and sprung-frame latching are meaningfully different from two-tool countertorque calibration and hands-off cycle retention.
